error: We couldn't update your tip. Try again.
notEditable: The tip can't be changed in this checkout.
editorDisabled: Tipping is turned off. Turn it on in the app under Tipping.
editorNotSetUp: Tipping isn’t set up yet. Click “Set up tipping” in the app under Tipping.
editorNoCustomer: Only logged-in customers whose “Allowed tipping” metafield is on see the tip selector. Shopify gives this block the customer only after protected customer data access is approved for the app.
editorNotAllowed: This customer’s “Allowed tipping” metafield is off, so they don’t see the tip selector.
